---
title: stats.comparison.paired_comparison
---



```python
stats.comparison.paired_comparison(a, b, *, lower_is_better=True)
```

Compare two entries on their shared periods with a paired t-test.

Aligns the two per-period score series on their common index, drops
periods where either is missing, and reports the per-side means, the
win count of the first entry, and a two-sided paired t-test — the
shared-days comparison protocol for leaderboard entries with
different coverage.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                                     | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| a               | [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | Per-period scores of the first entry (e.g. daily MAE).                           | _required_ |
| b               | [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | Per-period scores of the second entry.                                           | _required_ |
| lower_is_better | [bool](`bool`)                           | Whether a strictly smaller score is a win for the first entry. Defaults to True. | `True`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                                       | Description                                   |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|
|        | [PairedComparison](`spotforecast2_safe.stats.comparison.PairedComparison`) | A `PairedComparison` over the shared periods. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | When ``a`` or ``b`` is not a ``pd.Series``.                |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | When fewer than two shared periods remain after alignment. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#7d257ac6 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
from spotforecast2_safe.stats.comparison import paired_comparison

days = pd.date_range("2026-06-10", periods=6, freq="D")
a = pd.Series([500.0, 520.0, 480.0, 510.0, 490.0, 505.0], index=days)
b = a + 40.0  # consistently worse
result = paired_comparison(a, b)
print(result.n, result.wins_a, round(result.p_value, 6))
assert result.wins_a == 6
```
